newsitem.title: USA: Stallone's 'Rocky' movies get postal tribute.
newsitem.headline: Stallone's 'Rocky' movies get postal tribute.

text.p: Actor Sylvester Stallone has been beaten up frequently in his movie career and soon he will take more lickings when a set of postage stamps featuring the actor comes out this week.

To mark the 20th anniversary of his movie "Rocky," on Thursday five nations will unveil five postage stamps in a ceremony at the Planet Hollywood restaurant in New York, said the New York-based Inter-Governmental Philatelic Corp. (IGPC), which is organising the issue of the stamps.
The tribute marks the first time in history that a living individual, other than a member of the British royal family, has been commemorated by multiple countries, IGPC said.

Gambia, Ghana, Uganda, St. Vincent and Grenada will each issue a stamp featuring Stallone as the title character in each of the five "Rocky" films, which feature a down-and-out boxer who wins against heavy odds.

"Obviously, the 'Rocky' films hold a very special place in my heart, and I am honoured that these five countries feel that they warrant such a historic tribute," said Stallone, who will attend the ceremony in New York.
Fans will not have to travel to each of the countries to get their hands on the stamps, as a set of all five will also be sold at Planet Hollywood locations for $11.95.
